en: The Sutra Spoken by the Buddha on Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva.
At that time, Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva was dwelling in the southern world of Vaiḍūrya.
With his pure divine eye, he beheld the sentient beings suffering within the hells, being pounded with iron pestles and ground upon iron mills.
They are plowed with iron plows and sawn apart with iron saws;
they are boiled in cauldrons of surging, bubbling water over fierce fires that blaze like the heavens;
and when hungry, they swallow glowing iron balls.
They drink molten copper in their thirst,
undergoing various sufferings and afflictions without respite.
Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha could not bear to see this.
He immediately came from the south and arrived at the hell,
where he sat upon a separate couch together with King Yama.
There are four causes and conditions for this.
First, there is the fear that King Yama’s judgment will not be impartial;
second, there is the fear that legal documents will become entangled;
third, there is the fear that one has not yet reached the time for death.
Fourth, having finished their retribution for sins, they emerge from the edge of the hell-pool.
If there are good men or good women who fashion an image of the Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha, [they shall attain this].
If one copies the Sūtra of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva and recites the name of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva,
this person will certainly attain rebirth in the Western World of Ultimate Bliss.
From one buddha-field to another buddha-field,
from one celestial realm to another celestial realm—
should anyone create an image of the Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha.
If one copies the Sūtra of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva and recites the name of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva,
this person will certainly attain rebirth in the Western World of Ultimate Bliss.
On the day this person relinquishes their life,
Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva will personally come to welcome them,
and they shall always dwell together with Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva in one place.
Having heard what the Buddha had spoken, they were all greatly rejoiced, and they faithfully accepted and practiced it.
*The Scripture on the Bodhisattva Kṣitigarbha Spoken by the Buddha*, one fascicle.
